note: Pre-registered before any BL-050 run (backlog/BL-050-momentum-filter-poc.md Phase 0 and the owner's 2026-10-09 answers). Never edit after a run; supersede with bl050_criteria_addendum_N.json.
comparator: search_spaces/bl010_phase6_frozen.json exactly: four configs at their frozen offsets, equal capital reset each April, signal_delay 1, itemised costs + 15 bps, Rs 2 lakh, pre-tax; turnover_rank universe, curated tags

holdout.rule: one run per Phase 3 survivor plus the baseline, over 2012-01-01..2026-09-25, reading only the 2024-01-01.. slice; never before Phase 3 verdicts are written

V1.definition: median daily turnover (Rs) over the last 4 weeks / median daily turnover over the last 26 weeks, EQ bars up to the decision Friday

V2.definition: sum of weekly turnover in up weeks / sum in down weeks over the last 13 weeks (reversal.py's up/down split, turnover instead of share volume); a zero denominator reads as the 95th percentile of that week

V3.definition: passes if last week's turnover <= the median weekly turnover of the 26 weeks before it (quiet), or weekly turnover rose in each of the last 3 weeks (w-3 < w-2 < w-1 < w0, building); fails otherwise: no new buy that week

R1.definition: passes if the stock's 26-week return > Nifty 500 TRI's 26-week return

M1.definition: fails if close / 10-week average close is in the top 5% of that week's point-in-time universe

M2.definition: 26-week sum of residuals (weeks t-29..t-4) from a trailing 52-week regression with intercept of weekly returns on Nifty 500 TRI's weekly return; not divided by their std

T1.definition: annualised slope of log weekly close over 26 weeks x R^2 of that linear fit

tilt.rule: inside each config's effective stock ranking (the order the engine buys and exits by, after the config's own stock tilt if any), final = (1 - w) x that rank + w x the feature's rank among the same names that week (best = 1), re-ranked; ties by name

gate_rule: a failing name may not be bought that week (run_broad_backtest extra_no_buy); never forces a sale

phase_2_screen.sample: for each frozen config, at each of its own rebalance dates in the development window, the top quintile of the point-in-time universe by that config's own global score
phase_2_screen.split: tilts: top half vs bottom half of the feature within that set; gates: passed vs blocked
phase_2_screen.measure: 13-week forward return from the weekly closes, net of a 0.3% round trip; the per-date spread (better group minus worse group); Newey-West t-statistic with lag ceil(13 / cadence)
phase_2_screen.pass: the mean of the four per-config t-statistics >= 2 in the pre-registered direction AND at least 3 of the 4 configs have the right sign; otherwise killed. The screen is per feature: a tilt's two weights share its screen verdict
phase_2_screen.report: names blocked per week for gates (noted, never tuned)

phase_3_engine.runs: all 11 trials through all four frozen configs on the development window; ensemble by choose.ensemble_curve
phase_3_engine.pbo: CSCV over the 11 trial ensembles plus the baseline (S = 16 blocks), on weekly log returns
pass_for_screen_survivors_only: median dCAGR >= +2.0 pts across rolling 3-year windows stepped quarterly
CAGR win share across those windows >= 70%
full-period max drawdown no more than 3 pts worse than the baseline
phase_3_engine.report: average holdings and cash share next to every result

holdout_pass: dCAGR >= 0 and max drawdown no more than 3 pts worse, on 2024-01-01..2026-09-25
phase_4: not run tonight (owner: phases 0-3); each survivor would get its own shadow arm
will_not_run: fundamentals, the ETF track, market-wide trend/breadth/choppiness gates, cash-hurdle momentum, 52-week-high proximity, RSI, ADX, RS momentum / RRG, delivery %
any third tilt weight or second setting for a gate
